_note: Kimodo text-to-motion takes for skills where the Mixamo stock clip was weak (docs/design/172). 3 seeds each; the chosen take is copied to art/anim/kimodo/<id>.fbx.

ain_4.why: Mixamo Great Sword Blocking is nearly static
ain_4.prompt: A person braces in a wide stance and raises a two-handed sword horizontally above the head to block a heavy strike, then shoves it away.

ain_1.why: Mixamo Great Sword Slash is 3.53 s
ain_1.prompt: A person swings a large two-handed weapon in a wide horizontal arc from right to left while stepping forward.

kain_R.why: the anvil finisher should read as one huge overhead slam
kain_R.prompt: A person raises a heavy two-handed hammer high above the head and slams it down onto the ground with great force.

ryu_1.prompt: A person performs a fast flurry of slashes with two daggers while stepping forward.

sera_1.why: a quicker throw than Mixamo Throw
sera_1.prompt: A person quickly throws a small object overhand at a target in front of them.

kain_leap.why: doc 178: Guts-style leap slam (Kain skill 4) - windup, jump, hang, crash down
kain_leap.prompt: A person crouches low, leaps high into the air while raising a huge two-handed sword over the head, then falls and smashes it down into the ground with enormous force, landing in a deep crouch.

kain_sweep.why: doc 178: Kain skill 3 - one huge spinning sweep
kain_sweep.prompt: A person twists the torso far back holding a huge heavy two-handed sword, then spins a full circle sweeping the blade horizontally around the body, and staggers to a stop.

sf_rise.why: doc 181: Shadow Fang flurry - coil and spring up
sf_rise.prompt: A creature crouches very low with arms pulled in, then springs straight up into the air with arms spread wide.

sf_flurry.why: doc 181: Shadow Fang flurry - airborne rapid slashes
sf_flurry.prompt: A person slashes wildly and very fast with both arms clawing left and right in rapid alternating strikes, leaning forward aggressively.

sf_dive.why: doc 181: Shadow Fang flurry - dive and stuck
sf_dive.prompt: A person dives down from above and slams both hands into the ground, then stays hunched over, stuck and panting.

sf_thrust.why: doc 181: Shadow Fang silent thrust - frozen coil, explosive lunge
sf_thrust.prompt: A person crouches completely still with one arm pulled far back like a drawn spear, then explodes forward in a long lunging thrust, stabbing straight ahead with the arm fully extended, and slides to a stop off balance.

s09_combo.why: doc 181: Subject 09 rhythm-breaking frenzy combo (Orphan of Kos)
s09_combo.prompt: A person attacks in a wild frenzy: two quick swings, a sudden pause, then three fast heavy swings with irregular timing, lurching and stumbling forward between strikes.

s09_roar.prompt: A person hunches over, then rears up with both arms thrown wide to the sky and screams, body shaking.

clave_tele.why: doc 181: Clave delayed overhead strike after teleport (Radahn)
clave_tele.prompt: A person raises a heavy weapon slowly high over the head with both hands and holds it there, frozen, then brings it crashing straight down very hard.

ain_parry.why: counter (parry) motion: the Graybox block is a static guard (docs/design/183 §5)
ain_parry.prompt: A person holding a long two-handed polearm quickly raises it diagonally in front of the body to deflect a strike coming from above, the weapon is knocked back slightly, then the person returns to a ready stance.

ain_riposte.why: riposte on a broken boss: step in, weapon high, drive it down into the fallen enemy (docs/design/183 §3)
ain_riposte.prompt: A person steps forward, lifts a long two-handed weapon high above the head, then drives it straight down hard into an enemy lying on the ground in front, and holds the pose for a moment.
